text:
anya: Quick sync 1: The Bulk Edit form is causing a bunch of accessibility notes. Primary issues: required indicators, error summary behavior after bulk submit, and the bulk-delete confirmation flow.

Tom: For required fields in the grid, can we avoid appending '(Required)' on every cell? It gets noisy. Maybe show a visible asterisk and include a screen-reader-only token that announces 'required' before the label.

Rachel: Agree on sr-only token. Also request that the column header explains "asterisk indicates required" via an accessible tooltip or a hidden description for screen readers. That helps discoverability without clutter.

Vega: On errors: when you bulk-submit and multiple rows fail, we currently render a long alert at the top. Screen readers don't always jump to it. We should use an assertive live region for the form-level summary and provide row-level polite announcements as each row's inline error appears.

anya: Proposed behavior: on submit, focus moves to the error summary at the top (role=alert / aria-live=assertive). Each failing cell should also update a polite live region so screen readers can get context when moving through rows.

Tom: Implementation note: keep DOM order stable. don't insert new nodes above the submit bar that reflow the table. Instead reveal an already-present summary placeholder and move focus into it.

Rachel: For inline error spacing, we should reserve a 1-line slot under each cell so the grid doesn't jump. Show subtle fade-in. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Vega: Bulk-delete path: when deleting >1 row or deleting rows that have dependent resources, security wants a typed confirmation. I propose: typed confirm only when deleting more than 3 items or when a dependent resource flag is present. Otherwise, standard modal + undo toast.

anya: Copy idea for typed confirm: "Permanently delete 12 selected items and their snapshots. This cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm." Thoughts on requiring the exact resource name vs generic 'DELETE'?

Tom: Requiring exact resource names for many items is painful. Generic keyword like DELETE is OK for bulk as long as we show a clear list of affected resources and require a review step.

Rachel: Accessibility nit: the typed-confirm input must be labeled and linked with aria-describedby that lists the count and any special warnings. Also do not block paste. Allow paste but show an inline hint if the input was pasted (small badge) so user knows.

Vega: Backend must normalize comparisons (unicode, trimming). Front-end should do liveMatches but server enforces. Also log the deletion intent for audit.

anya: Decision summary: 1) visible asterisk + sr-only "required" token read before labels; 2) column header explains the asterisk for discoverability; 3) reserve one-line error slot per cell with fade-in (respect reduced-motion); 4) on bulk-submit move focus to assertive summary (role=alert) and also update polite live regions at cell-level; 5) typed-confirm for >3 items or flagged dependencies (keyword DELETE allowed, paste allowed); 6) server-side normalization and audit logging. Any objections?

Tom: +1

Rachel: +1

Vega: +1

anya: I'll create the quick prototype and spec form behaviors. Will include copy variants and ARIA attributes. Assigning follow-ups in the ticket. :zap:
